newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Aug-Oct 96 industrial sales up 2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Danish Aug-Oct 96 industrial sales up 2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Danish industrial sales rose by two percent in current prices in August-October 1996 with orders four percent up, compared to the same period last year, the national statistics bureau said on Friday.

The manufacturing price index rose by one percent in August-October 1996 compared to the same period last year, while the quantity index, indicating trends in turnover of goods and services, showed a three percent year-on-year gain.
